name: Domination
description: Demo of the toggle block (programFormat 4, firmware 2.10). Two teams run between the pods and the central and press them: every press flips a pod between red and blue (cooldown 0.5 s). After 20 s, or as soon as all pods have one colour, the pods stay lit in their final colour for 3 s. The score is in the variables RED_PODS / BLUE_PODS (pods), RED_MS / BLUE_MS (owned time) and FLIPS. Needs two peripherals with firmware 2.10 (link feature 'toggle'); older pods are left out of the game.
